title: On-Adapter-TA: trained adapter (round-3 a0e15) with a backbone-first abstaining gate
frozen_at: 2026-10-09, after the round-4 seed-2 test (S = 1.008974, not first) and before any round-5 test computation
exploratory_disclosure: Motivated by four test post-mortems: validation improvements of calibrations and of the trained adapter reversed on several test tasks. Exploratory iteration on an already observed test period. Validation screens round5/dev/h7_abstain_screen.py and h8_abstain_multi.py were inspected before freezing (the latter showed the original online-update expert fails late in validation and is excluded).

hypothesis.problem: The trained adapter helps on some test streams and hurts on others, and validation cannot tell which in advance.
hypothesis.change: On-Adapter emits its internal frozen-backbone forecast by default and switches to the trained adapter forecast T only while T's gs-discounted mean per-origin MAE over at least 4 fully matured origins is below (1 - mu) x the backbone's (hysteresis: an active T stays while it is below the backbone's); otherwise it abstains back to the backbone.
hypothesis.falsified_if: the selected candidate's seed-2 test S is not below every baseline

selection: seed-2 validation stream r=0 of the round-3 a0e15 checkpoints; score = max(whole-stream geometric mean over 36 tasks of the CVaR90 ratio to iTransformer, largest per-third geometric mean); argmin; ties toward larger mu, then larger gs
formal_test: selected candidate applied once to the existing round-3 a0e15 test trajectories (r=0); frozen cell_metrics against the fixed seed-2 baselines; fraction of origins using the adapter reported per task
information_boundary: the gate uses only targets/masks of origins with o + H <= t at forecast time t; the backbone forecast is computed inside On-Adapter from the frozen seed-2 iTransformer checkpoint
